descriptions.zh:
在§H[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!带来破坏的余波中，我们取得了许多对这些宇宙自然现象的洞见。

通过研究星际气象学，我们可以在未来更好地保护自己。这一全新的研究领域可能将会得出完全驾驭这些风暴的手段。
descriptions.en:
In the aftermath of the devastation from the §H[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!, we have gained some unique insight on these galactic phenomena.

By studying astrometeorology, we can better protect ourselves in the future. This new field of research might eventually yield the means to master these storms.

descriptions.zh:
自从探测到[From.Planet.GetName]的那一刻起，它就一直吸引着我们的目光。

在这样一个广阔而混乱的星系中，两个天体相撞并不是什么罕见的事情。不过，在此前类似的碰撞中，至少相撞的其中一个或者全部两个都会被摧毁。

让[From.Planet.GetName]变成现在样子的碰撞发生在数百万年前，但这两颗星球却保持着一种奇怪的平衡，甚至在这一过程中还形成了维护生命体的大气层。
descriptions.en:
From the moment we detected [From.Planet.GetName], its mere existence has been a source of fascination.

It is not the collision of two celestial objects that is unusual, as the galaxy is a vast and chaotic place. However, in all known instances of such an impact, one or both of the bodies in question was destroyed.

The collision that formed [From.Planet.GetName] took place millions of years ago, and yet these two worlds maintain a strange equilibrium, and have even formed a life-sustaining atmosphere in the process.

descriptions.zh:
“相撞行星”上的情况远比预期的更加危险。最近一连串的地震又揭开了曾经相撞地区的伤疤，大量岩浆从地表喷涌而出。全球变暖和遮天蔽日的火山灰已经开始影响行星地表的各种生物。

更糟糕的是，根据预测结果，如果我们不能在接下来的50年中稳定这对行星，那么行星板块活动将愈演愈烈，并最终使[From.Planet.GetName]解体！
descriptions.en:
The situation on the so-called "collided planet" has turned out to be far more precarious than anticipated. A recent series of earthquakes opened up the old scars around the impact zone, causing a significant amount of magma to erupt from the ground. Various planetary biomes are already beginning to suffer from rising global temperatures and the volcanic ash that clouds the skies.

To make matters worse, if the joint planets are not stabilized within the next 50 years, our readings predict that tectonic activity will continue to escalate, ultimately causing the complete disintegration of [From.Planet.GetName]!

descriptions.zh:
我们顶尖的地质学家齐聚于此，提出了两条可行的方案来拯救处于恐怖地壳活动之中的[From.Planet.GetName]。

第一个计划是稳定当前状态，尽管填补撞击区域周围的火山需要数个世纪之久，但是我们可以先小心地在地表进行钻孔，减小地壳压力，避免板块失稳。残余的火山产物将用于改造行星，塑造一个稳定的生态环境。

第二个计划就比较宏大了，与其减轻地壳压力，我们不如利用火山喷发产生的能量和物质来开展定向的环境改造。

这种方法使我们能够塑造出多种生态环境，让不同的生命在此生存，将这个星球变为天堂。然而，该计划失败的可能性很大，甚至可能导致这颗独特的星球完全毁灭。
descriptions.en:
Our top geologists came together and formed two possible plans to save the [From.Planet.GetName] from succumbing to tectonic terror.

The first plan is to stabilize the collision. While it would take many centuries to heal the volcanic wound around the impact zone, through careful terrestrial trepanning we can alleviate the pressure on the planet's crust, preventing further tectonic instability. The remaining volcanic byproducts will be used to terraform the planet into a stable biome.

The second plan is far more ambitious. Instead of alleviating the pressure on the planet's crust, the energy and materials generated by the volcanic eruption could be adapted to a tailored terraforming process.

This approach allows us to sculpt a multitude of biomes capable of sustaining every type of lifeform, turning this world into a paradise. However, there is a significant chance that this procedure will fail - and could even lead to the complete and utter destruction of this unique stellar body.

label.zh: 我们选择稳定当前状态。
我们选择利用火山产物。

descriptions.zh:
我们稳定被撞星球的努力得到了回报！先前威胁[From.Planet.GetName]的地震已经被平息，火山带来的产物也如同我们预想中一样迅速减少，这颗星球又回复到了最初处于脆弱平衡的状态。

眼下环境改造的问题在于：[From.Planet.GetName]改造的方向应该是什么？
descriptions.en:
Our efforts to stabilize the collided world paid off! The tremors that previously threatened [From.Planet.GetName]'s existence have been silenced and the volcanic byproducts are rapidly decreasing as we speak, returning the world to its fragile balance.

One question remains for our final terraforming push: which class of planet shall [From.Planet.GetName] become?

label.zh: 保持当前的陆地星球状态。

descriptions.zh:
令人震惊的是，我们原以为这些工作只能堪堪稳定[collided_planets.GetName]，没想到我们的成果远超预期。

看，这是一个天堂，一个能够让你想象中所有生命形式生活的天堂。

拯救了一个走向毁灭的世界，并将其改造成了现在这副振奋人心的模样——还有什么比这更伟大的成就呢？命运女神无疑是眷顾我们的。
descriptions.en:
Extraordinary! We thought our efforts would only go as far as to stabilize [collided_planets.GetName], but it turned into something so much more!

Behold, a paradise, a planet capable of sustaining nearly every form of life imaginable.

To be able to save a doomed world and to transform it into something this inspiring - has there ever been a greater accomplishment? Fortune surely favors us.

descriptions.zh:

拯救了一个走向毁灭的世界，并将其改造成了现在这副振奋人心的模样——还有什么比这更伟大的成就呢？命运女神无疑是眷顾我们的。
descriptions.en:
Behold, a paradise, a planet capable of sustaining nearly every form of life imaginable.

To be able to save a doomed world and to transform it into something this inspiring - has there ever been a greater accomplishment? Fortune surely favors us.

descriptions.zh:
尽管星球本身幸存下来了，但将其改造为天堂的努力却付诸东流了。

行星严峻的地壳活动阻碍了我们对生态环境的改造，不过不稳定的状况似乎已经结束了。火山活动则回到了之前的水平，尽管在撞击区域火山依旧活跃，但短时间内不太可能再次升级。

最坏的时期似乎已经过去了。现在我们所面临的挑战是重建这颗星球。
descriptions.en:
While the world itself was thankfully saved, our endeavor to terraform the collided planet into a paradise has failed.

Our attempts to tailor the biome were frustrated by the planet's severe tectonic activity, although the worst of the destabilization appears to be over. Volcanic activity has returned to the levels first witnessed before the recent upheaval, and while the impact site remains active, it is unlikely to escalate any time soon.

The worst appears to be over. Our challenge now is to rebuild this world.

descriptions.zh:
我们试图拯救濒临毁灭的被撞行星的努力付诸东流了。尽管科学家们采取了一切可能的预防措施，但他们的模型从未能考虑到所有情况。

随着星球的残骸逐渐漂向虚空，整个星系都为这一奇景的消失而哀悼。
descriptions.en:
Our attempt to save the collided planet from impending doom has failed miserably. While our scientists took every possible precaution, their models were never able to take every contingency into account.

As the remnants of these worlds drift ever further into the void, the galaxy mourns the loss of this unique phenomenon.

descriptions.zh: 被撞行星的毁灭进程完全按照我们的所预测的时间线进行，准确度精确到十分位。这个曾经一度点缀了星海的奇景，如今除了空留下一堆岩石，什么也没有剩下。
descriptions.en: The collapse of the collided planet followed our timeline predictions down to the decimal. Where once the galaxy was enriched by a unique phenomenon, now nothing but rocks remain.

descriptions.zh:
从远处看，[From.GetName]就像那些红色珠宝一样散发着光芒。对于这样一种地质异常现象，通常可能的原因是因为有黏土或者是其他种类的土壤中夹杂了硬金属。但这次的事实要更为离奇。

那是虫子，上万亿条虫子。它们聚集在一起，密密麻麻地铺满了[From.GetName]表面。

我们快速将其命名为“猩红爬虫”，这群无脊椎生物的繁殖周期十分短。尽管没有破坏自然环境，但它们四处蠕动，搞得[From.GetName]不适合开展殖民。

有人提出了一条不怎么正经的方法来处理这些昆虫。初步扫描显示它们是可食用的，或许我们可以把它们当作新的食物来源？不管怎样，至少我们建议先调查一下。
descriptions.en:
From a distance, [From.GetName]'s shone like some precious crimson jewel. Clay or other soil types infused with hard metals would be the usual explanation for such a geographical anomaly, but the truth was far more bizarre.

Bugs. Trillions, upon trillions, of bugs. They swarm over the surface of [From.GetName] in an almost unbroken carpet of multi-legged life.

Quickly dubbed the 'crimson crawlers', these invertebrates possess a remarkably hyperactive reproduction cycle. While not harmful to their native environment, [From.GetName] is not well suited for colonization with these creatures scurrying about.

One rather unorthodox method of handling the insects has been proposed. Initial scans show they are edible, so perhaps we have found a new food source? We advise at least investigating the opportunity.

descriptions.zh:
一开始，大家都觉得把这种猩红爬虫当作食物有点太荒谬了。但在把一份虫子标本带回船上后，人们觉得吃这些虫子也不是不能接受。

这些虫子简直是奇迹的造物，神经系统极其先进，但是却没有大脑这种中枢处理器官。更重要的是，它们浅色的肉出人意料地嫩滑多汁，哪怕是生吃，猩红的外骨骼尝起来也既酥脆又美味。

现在的问题是，这些虫子是更适合作为研究材料，还是更适合作为一种美味的食物。把它们做成菜肴会带来更多风味和乐趣，但特别是在搭配适当调味品的情况下直接生吃会更快更简单。
descriptions.en:
The idea of consuming the crimson crawlers may have seemed preposterous at first, but when a specimen was brought on board, it became far more palatable.

The insects are a creature of wonder, possessing an extremely advanced nervous system without the benefit of a central processing organ. More importantly, their pale flesh is surprisingly tender and moist, and even when consumed raw, the vermillion-hued exoskeleton was deemed both crispy and delightful.

The question remains as to whether the bugs would better serve as research material or as a delectable source of food. Cooking them might provide more flavor and fun, but eating them as they come will be quicker and easier, especially if paired with the appropriate condiment.

descriptions.zh:
尽管这座轨道复合体被宇宙风暴拖拽着漂星过海，但它似乎没怎么受到损伤。我们发现居住站中的居住和商业空间几乎状态完好。这些区域一尘不染，仿佛从未有人使用过一般。

在中控室中迎接我们的是一个令人眼花缭乱的输入系统：各种没有任何说明的刻度盘，设置不一的拉杆，大量的按钮以看似随机的间隔五颜六色地闪烁着。幸运的是，我们最终找到了一本手册。相信只要成功翻译出来，我们就可以重新激活这座居住站了。
descriptions.en:
Despite having been dragged across the galaxy by the cosmic storm, the orbital complex suffered very little harm. We found the living and commercial spaces of the habitat in almost perfect condition. Not a single bit of dust laid atop the surface that would betray a previous occupancy, as if it had never before been used.

Inside the central control hub we were greeted by a bewildering input system: dials with no explanation, levers with inconsistent settings and a great amount of buttons flashing a whole spectrum of colors at seemingly random intervals. Fortunately, we eventually came across a manual. Once this is successfully translated, we are confident we can reactivate the habitat.

descriptions.zh:
不幸的是，我们之前的估计过于乐观了：翻译出来的手册和这个控制系统一样令人无法理解。不仅缺失了一半的页面，图片说明上有着大量的符号学设定，而且另一半手册则是用一种难以破译的象形文字书写的。

然而，最后一页展示了一个通讯频率并附有一组可翻译成“帮助台”的字符。我们现在正尝试联络这个频率。
descriptions.en:
Unfortunately, our previous estimation appears to have been optimistic: the manual turned out to be just as incomprehensible as the control system. Half of the pages appeared to be missing and the pictorial instructions make significant semiotic assumptions. The other half of the manual is written in difficult to interpret hieroglyphs.

However, the last page displayed a com frequency accompanied by a set of characters translated to 'help desk'. We're attempting this frequency now.

titles.zh: 您的来电对我们很重要
titles.en: Your Call is Important To Us

descriptions.zh:
手册中的通讯频道连接到了一个名为“天空花园”的商业实体的帮助台主机。

助手人工智能用一种友好而中立的语气告诉我们，它感谢我们的联系，并询问是否有什么可以帮得上忙的。列出的选项包括“回答有关订阅的问题”、“了解新的智能防御系统”，以及我们是否希望更多地了解该公司的“社会责任倡议”。

然而，随后的选项把我们引向越来越不相关的话题。更糟的是，它还经常会让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]等待，然后切断通讯。显然，这个人工智能服务并没有像居住站的其他部分一样经受住时间的考验。

无论如何，我们将继续按自己的方法来试着搞定这个神秘的系统。
descriptions.en:
The manual's com frequency connected us to the help desk mainframe of a commercial entity known as Skygarden.

With a friendly though neutral tone, the help desk AI informed us that it appreciated our reaching out, and asked if there was anything it could aid us with. Among the listed options were 'answering questions about subscriptions', 'learning about the new line of smart defense systems' and if we wished to know more about the corporation's 'social responsibility initiatives'.

However, the subsequent options continued to direct us to entirely unrelated topics. Worse of all, it would often put our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on hold only to drop the call. Obviously, the service AI has not survived the passing of time as well as the rest of the habitat.

Nevertheless, we will continue trying to find our way through this arcane system.

options.script: name = UNDERSTOOD

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报，无论他们和人工智能说什么，在几分钟的等待过去后，这个系统都只会复读之前的内容。

我们尝试运行多个模拟来绘制精确的菜单树，但是却发生了递归错误，并且无法同时解决和检查解决方案。即使运行量子模型也没有得到理想的结果。我们怀疑在这个过程中我们不小心破坏了一些波函数。

我们不知所措了。
descriptions.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] report that regardless of what they said to the AI, after passing through several menus, the system would simply revert back to a previous statement.

We attempted to run several simulations to map out the exact menu tree, but our efforts returned recursive errors and an inability to both solve and check the solution at the same time. Even running a quantum model achieved no desirable results. We suspect we accidentally collapsed a few wave functions in the process.

We're at a loss.

label.zh: 告诉这个人工智能它的§R违禁词§!被§R违禁词§!了。

descriptions.zh:
终于有进展了！这个人工智能警告我们用语不当，并告知我们应该等待客户服务代表的联系。

我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。

向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
descriptions.en:
Finally a breakthrough! The AI admonished us for using inappropriate language and stated we should wait until we are contacted by a customer service representative.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

titles.en: Years to Earn, Seconds to Lose

descriptions.zh:
有了新的指南后，重新启动居住站毫不费力。

在机器启动的声音慢慢平息后，我们决定再一次向记录员表示感谢。

她说在这个通讯台找到了一些信息，显然，这是五个多世纪前建造的原型，但在一场特别恶劣的宇宙风暴之后，迷失于混沌太空之中。财产损失和开发成本的打水漂就够让天空花园破产的了。

帮助我们是这位记录员多年来第一件有意义的服务。

“再说了，”她说。“我也很高兴能再次听到我曾祖母的声音，即使只是一个人工智能而已。”
descriptions.en:
With the new guide in our possession, restarting the habitat required little effort.

After the noise of activating machinery slowly died down, we decided to reach out to the record keeper once more to thank her.

She told us she had recovered some information on this station. Apparently it had been built over five centuries ago as a prototype, but was lost in the astrological chaos following a particularly nasty cosmic storm. The loss of property and development costs was enough to bankrupt Skygarden.

Helping us was the record keeper's first useful task in years.

"Besides," she said. "It was nice to hear my great-grandmother's voice on the line again, even it was just an AI."

descriptions.zh:
我们从[This.GetName]星系接收到了一些奇怪的报告。显然，上一场在该星域肆虐的宇宙风暴把一艘不知来处的舰船卷了出来。这艘船没有呼号，它不知怎么地穿过了暴风雨，仿佛完全没受周围风暴的影响。

这艘船没有回应我们的呼叫，风暴消散后，它也消失得无影无踪了。这可能是由于风暴对仪器的干扰，但是肉眼观测却毋庸置疑地表明了真相。

这其中可能潜藏着极为先进的科技，还是说发生了某些不祥的事情？我们会时刻盯着这艘神秘舰船，直到它再次出现。
descriptions.en:
We are receiving strange reports from the [This.GetName] system. Apparently, the last cosmic storm raging in that sector revealed a ship of unknown origin. Bearing no call sign, it somehow cruised through the tempest as if entirely unaffected by the surrounding violence.

It did not respond to hails, and as soon as the storm dissipated, so did the vessel itself. This might have been dismissed as instrument artifacting, but the visual evidence spoke for itself.

Could this be a display of incredibly advanced technology, or is there something more ominous at play? We will be sure to report back any occurrences of this mysterious vessel.

descriptions.zh:
[This.GetName]中的一座研究站带给了我们一份惊人的报告：在上一次宇宙风暴肆虐期间，一艘奇怪的舰船差点就撞上了哨站。肉眼观测表明，这艘船就是之前报告的那艘不详的舰船。

据空间站汇报，这艘舰船的船体由奇异的有机物、钙矿以及金属合金的融合体构成。

在船上没有探测到任何有机生命的迹象，这让我们推测这艘船是不是自动化或者是由于某些意外而失去了控制。

然而，最令人困惑的事情是，太空碎片已经将这艘船的大部分推进系统击碎，它本应难逃崩坏的命运。

如果我们能派遣科研船监测下一次宇宙风暴的话，说不定可以获得有关这艘飞船的更多信息。
descriptions.en:
One of the research stations in [This.GetName] came to us with a startling report: During the last cosmic storm, a strange ship had almost collided with the outpost. Visual reports show it was the same ominous vessel first reported some time ago.

According to the space station, the hulls on the vessel were constructed from a strange amalgamation of organic compounds, calcium minerals and metallic alloys.

No organic life was detected, leading us to speculate that either this vessel was automated, or had somehow gone rogue.

However, the most baffling thing was yet to come: large sections of its propulsion system were clearly shattered by space debris. This vessel should have been dead in space.

If we assign a science vessel to monitor the next cosmic storm, they might be able to find out more about this mysterious craft.

label.zh: 我们没时间理会这无稽之谈。
label.en: We have no time for such nonsense.

descriptions.zh:
[stormbound_science.GetName]远远地发现那艘不祥的舰船出现在风暴之中。当它飘过时，我们从宇宙空间中探测到了一股强烈的信号。

我们无法探测到这艘船的原因终于真相大白：它的物理形态已经伸展得超越了多维空间，看上去就好像已经进入了虫洞又好像没有。可能是由于宇宙风暴的多维起源，这艘船才得以回到我们的空间。

知道这一点后，当这艘船下次再出现时，我们应该能够探测到，说不定还能将它拉回到我们的现实中。
descriptions.en:
In the distance [stormbound_science.GetName] witnessed the ominous ship appearing between the layers of the storm. As it floated by, we detected wild readings emanating from the cosmic tapestry.

This finally provided an answer to why this ship could not be observed by our sensors: its physical manifestation had been stretched beyond the manifold, as if it had both entered and not entered a wormhole. It was likely due to the hyperdimensional origins of cosmic storms that the ship managed to return to our space.

Knowing this, we should be able to detect the next occurrence, and perhaps pull this craft back to our reality.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经在§Y[this.GetName]§!中发现了这艘不祥的舰船。
descriptions.en: The ominous ship has been sighted in §Y[this.GetName]§!.

options.script: name = INTRIGUING

descriptions.zh:
就在那里！那艘不祥的船只正位于[Root.Fleet.GetName]前方，并联络了我们。屏幕上出现了一个面带华丽面具的机械实体，她自称为碧廷，并向我们讲述了一则引人入胜的故事。

她曾是一位著名的指挥官，也是恩典公约这一组织的杰出代表。在一次巡逻途中，她和她的船员被卷入了宇宙风暴之中，为求得一线生机，她大胆将舰船的‘突破驱动装置’过载。这种实验性技术从未有人测试过，结果舰船连带船员们一起被困在了风暴的高维场中。

故事到此为止，她从严重损毁的船上抛出一个小匣子，里面放着一摞文件。“把这些拿回去吧，”碧廷请求道。之后通讯结束，舰船也随之消失在多维结空间结构中。

这些文件上都是外星文字，我们需要花点时间进行破译。
descriptions.en:
There it is! Positioning itself in front of [Root.Fleet.GetName], the ominous ship hailed us. A mechanical entity in an ornate mask appeared on screen. Identifying herself as B'Tiin, her tale was a fascinating one.

She was once a renowned officer, a true paragon of an organization known as the Convention of Benefactors. While on patrol, she and her crew were caught inside a cosmic storm, and in a daring bid for survival, she made the decision to overcharge the ship's 'Breach Drive.' This experimental technology had never been tested, and the vessel and its crew was trapped within the storm's hyperdimensional field.

Her story finished, a small container was released from the decimated ship. Inside was a collection of documents. "Take these home," B'Tiin requested, after which the transmission ended, and the ship disappeared into the spatial manifold.

The documents are written in a foreign script, and will take some time to decipher.

descriptions.zh:
古怪匣子中的文件已经被翻译完毕。其中一份文件记录了那艘船所谓“突破驱动装置”的设计图。尽管该装置仍超出我们的科技水平，但对其构造原理的仔细研究之后，我们对于超空间航行的理解更加深入了。

其余的则是一些私人信件，没有什么用处，但是却更能触动人心。这些信都是写给他们心爱的人，笔间填满了思念、希望和遗憾。

似乎碧廷的目的是想要让她的船员们有最后一次机会与外界联系。但不幸的是，我们不知道这些信要寄往何方，所以不如把这些信留下来，至少还可以保存他们这份奇异的遗产。或者我们也可以销毁这些信件，毕竟这艘古怪的舰船和幽灵般的信件有点让人内心发毛。
descriptions.en:
The contents of the strange container have been deciphered. One document contained a schematic of the ship's so-called Breach Drive. While still beyond our own technology, careful study of the principles behind its construction have already improved our understanding of hyperspatial travel.

Less beneficial perhaps, but more affecting, were the translations of personal letters. Each is addressed to a loved one, speaking of fondness, hope, and regret.

It seems B'Tiin's intention was to give her crew one last chance to reach out. Unfortunately, we have no way of knowing where to deliver these letters. Making them available to our own people could at least preserve their strange legacy. Alternatively, it might be wise to destroy them. Knowledge of strange ships and ghostly letters may be unsettling.

label.zh: 归档这些信件以供后人查询。

descriptions.zh:
这只生物自被发现以来就展现出极大的影响力，激发了我们的爱意和投喂欲。四只鼓起的泡泡般的眼睛展现着它的纯真，吸引所有人前来撸它那柔顺如云的毛发。它似乎很亲近[Root.GetLeaderName]，大部分时间都呆在[Leader.GetHisHer]的膝盖上，享受着[Leader.GetHisHer]的宠爱，没有展现出任何攻击或是危险动作，就好像是被特意设计成这副无害的模样。

尽管如此，一些人质疑，在未经事先批准的情况下，将一种以前未发现的生物留在船上是不负责任的。[Root.GetLeaderName]则保证它大概率是安全的，但也认可需要进行正式调查。
descriptions.en:
From the moment the creature was discovered, its impact was undeniable, inspiring love and devotion among us almost instantaneously. Its four bulging eyes displayed innocence and invited anyone to stroke its soft, cloud-like fur. It seems particularly attached to [Root.GetLeaderName], spending most of its time on [Leader.GetHisHer] lap enjoying [Leader.GetHisHer] affections, not showing any signs of aggression or danger. It is as if it was perfectly engineered to be as inoffensive as possible.

Still, some skeptics have pointed out how irresponsible it would be to keep a previously undiscovered life form aboard the ship without prior approval. [Root.GetLeaderName] vouched that it is definitely probably safe, but has agreed to request a formal investigation.

label.zh: 调查清楚它到底是什么。

label.en: Request denied. Get rid of it.

descriptions.zh:
我们不需要进行麻醉，也不需要强迫就能触摸并扫描这只动物，它表现得十分顺从。船员们根据它被抚摸时发出的声音将其命名为咕咕。

我们确认咕咕是杂食动物，它的毛发由常见且非常柔软的角蛋白丝组成。但真正神奇的事情是它的内在，它可以在一个月内更新包括自己神经系统在内的全部细胞。这意味着它可以在几天内再生出正常功能的躯体。

如此复杂的生物结构似乎不太可能是自然进化的产物。我们以前从未见过类似的生物，因此无法确定它的性情。尽管看起来温顺，但它随时可能对我们发起攻击。尽管如此，自从它出现以来，[Root.GetLeaderName]似乎比以往任何时候都更有工作动力。

我们应该怎么处理咕咕？我们能把它留下吗？
descriptions.en:
The docile hexapod did not need to be sedated or even coerced into being prodded and scanned. It seemed strangely agreeable. The crew nicknamed it Gurr, after the soft noise it makes when petted.

We have concluded that Gurr is an omnivore, and that its fur consists of familiar and very soft keratin-based filaments. But the true marvel and mystery takes place inside the adorable creature: it achieves total cell renewal within a month. This includes its nervous system, meaning that it could regrow fully functional body parts within a matter of days.

It seems unlikely something with such a sophisticated biological makeup is a product of natural evolution. We have never before seen anything like it, and cannot be certain of its temperament. Despite its apparent docility, it could turn on us at any moment. That said, since its appearance, [Root.GetLeaderName] seems more motivated to work than ever.

What shall we do with Gurr? Can we keep it?

label.en: As long as you clean up after it.

descriptions.zh:
这只可爱的生物被允许留在科研船上，目前已经被安置妥当。它安抚了[Root.GetLeaderName]的情绪，使其不论走到哪都神清气爽，船员们的士气也前所未有的高。

希望这个非凡的“自然”奇迹能继续成为我们所有人的可爱且温顺的朋友。它，咕咕，将属于我们，直到永远。
descriptions.en:
The adorable creature was allowed to stay aboard the science vessel and has since settled in nicely. It calms [Root.GetLeaderName], lightens the mood wherever it trots, and crew morale is at an all time high!

Hopefully this remarkable wonder of "nature" will continue to be a cute, docile, friend to all of us. From now until the end, it shall be ours, and it shall be named Gurr.

descriptions.zh:
鉴于这只动物的身体不同寻常并且明显经过基因改造，我们不能把它留在科学船上。它很有可能给船员带来负面影响，而且说不定它的主人什么时候就突然愤怒现身要求我们归还。决定执行得迅速且仁慈，在一瞬间，它那柔和的“咕咕”声就此永远消失了。

这个决定尽管情有可原，但还是引发了[Root.GetLeaderName]和船员的抗拒。他们还需要一些时间来平复失去这只可爱奇异动物的悲痛。
descriptions.en:
Given its unusual and clearly genetically engineered body, the creature could not stay aboard the science vessel. The risk of it adversely affecting the crew, or an aggrieved owner appearing to demand its return was simply too great. The deed was done swiftly and mercifully. In an instant, its soft "gurr" was silenced forever.

While understandable, this decision has prompted an emotional backlash from [Root.GetLeaderName] and the crew. It will take some time to get over the loss of this adorable freak of nature.

descriptions.zh:
处理掉这只可爱动物之后，事情没有就此结束，它出色的再生能力似乎超出了我们的预期。

在它死亡后不久，从那显然毫无生机的组织中诞生了两个完全相同的生物。即使杀死它们母体的人就是我们，这些新生的生命体也没有表现出任何攻击性。

我们决定就此打住，而不是冒险创造出一支咕咕大军。[Root.GetLeaderName]和船员们对能够留下这对生物感到非常高兴。
descriptions.en:
Neutralizing the adorable creature was meant to be the end of it, but its remarkable regenerative characteristics seemed to have gone further than we could have guessed.

Not too long after its demise, two identical copies of the creature were spawned from its apparently lifeless tissue. Even after our decision to terminate its progenitor's life, the resulting lifeforms are not showing any signs of aggression.

We shall leave it at this, rather than risk creating an army of Gurrs. [Root.GetLeaderName] and the crew have expressed their delight at being allowed to keep the pair.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现一个随风暴逐流的逃生舱。尽管数据签名看起来像是我们的，但可以肯定它不属于我们。我们谨慎地回应了通讯请求，而舱内人员显得尤为高兴。

[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeSheCap]解释称[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]已经随着风暴拉扯了一段时间，正寻求救援，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis]飞船上的生命维持系统已经濒临崩溃。

当我们要求其表明身份时，这个陌生人却奇怪地声称自己就是我们的船员。这显然是在撒谎，因为我们的船员一个不漏，都在船上。
descriptions.en:
The pod discovered in [From.Planet.GetName] has been left to the mercy of the storm. Even though the data signature it uses looks to be one of ours, the pod is definitely alien. We answered the request for communications cautiously, but we were met with elation by the capsule's inhabitant.

[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeSheCap] explained [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] has been dragged along by the tempest for some time and is seeking rescue, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis] vessel's life support systems on the brink of failure.

When asked to identify themselves, the stranger bizarrely claimed to be a member of our own crew. The lie is painfully obvious, if for no other reason than the fact that everyone on board our ship is accounted for.

label.zh: 别跟他兜圈子了，摧毁逃生舱。

descriptions.zh:
我们把逃生舱带上船了。我们打开太空舱的封条，真相就揭晓了，里面的外星人立即发出了绝望的请求。

原来这名外星人在对自己母舰的逃生舱进行例行检查时被困在的仓内，并且逃生舱被发射到了太空中。非常不幸的是，船上没有人发现[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]消失了。

在被困几个月之后，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]终于通过一些在逃生舱内能搞到的小东西，向路过的飞船发送一种诱饵信号。然而这也没能吸引到任何援手。更糟的是，一股宇宙风暴席卷了逃生舱，并把它带到了母星系好多光年之外的地方。在孤独和恐惧的驱使下，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]想出了一个计划，伪装成发生在附近的任何船只的失踪船员。这位逃生舱的幸存者为他欺骗了我们道歉，但[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]很庆幸自己活了下来。
descriptions.en:
We brought the escape pod aboard our ship. The ruse ended as soon as the capsule's seal opened, after which the alien within immediately launched into a desperate plea.

During a routine inspection of the escape pods on [event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis] mother ship, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] was trapped inside and ejected into space. Sadly, no one aboard their vessel noticed [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] was missing.

Stranded for months, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] used what little tech [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] could find aboard [event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis] pod to mimic the energy signals of passing ships as a type of lure. However, even this failed to attract help. Worst of all, a cosmic storm took hold of the pod, dragging it lightyears from its home system. Driven to extremes by loneliness and fear, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] concocted a plan to pose as a missing crew member of any ship that happened by. The pod-dweller apologized for the deception, but is glad to be alive.

label.zh: 我们或许能够用得上这样灵活的头脑。
提供交通工具送到附近的有人居住的星球。
label.en: Provide transport to the nearest inhabited planet.

descriptions.zh:
我们的基地附近出现了一片奇特的城市遗址。

这些建筑包含了我们迄今为止所遇到的每一个文明的建筑特点——也包括我们自己的！

然而，这些建筑所用的材料组成与我们在行星殖民过程中建立基地时使用的材料相似。这很奇怪，因为我们的这类材料不可能坚持数十年之久，更别提我们扫描确定的这些遗迹所经过的时间了。

这些遗址不太可能属于哪位神秘的先驱者，但扫描结果却与之相悖。这其中到底有什么玄机？
descriptions.en:
Near our basecamp we were greeted by a set of peculiar city ruins.

The architecture showed characteristics of every civilization we've encountered so far - including our own!

However, the material composition is similar to what we use to establish base camps during planetary colonization. This is strange because these materials could never hold out for multiple decades, let alone the age our scanners determined these ruins to be.

It's unlikely for these ruins to have belonged to a mysterious precursor, yet the scanners persist in their conclusion. What could be at play here?

descriptions.zh:
我们追踪信号进入了废墟城市的地下层。一般情况下，这类考古遗址都会存在一个交通相连的地下网络，或者有一批避难所。不过，我们发现了一个布满布料碎片、聚合物容器，甚至有机废物的小洞穴。看来我们并不是第一批探索这里的人。

令人担忧的是，[Root.GetLeaderName] 告诉我们外面的天空正在变绿，一场宇宙风暴即将在 [Fromfrom.getName] 形成。尽管如此，我们仍然向着信号的来源前进。
descriptions.en:
The trail of the signals led to a pathway into the lower levels of the ruined city. Usually archeological sites of this type have an underground transportation network or a collection of safety bunkers. Instead we found a small cave system littered with scraps of fabric, polymer containers and even organic waste. It appears we are not the first to explore this archeological site.

Worryingly, [Root.GetLeaderName] informs us the skies outside are turning green; a cosmic storm is about to develop inside [Fromfrom.getName]. Still, we press on towards the origin point of the signals.

descriptions.zh:
我们一时被一扇严重损毁的金属大门挡住去路，但还是不费吹灰之力就打开了通道，门后是一个简陋的仓库。

仓库的架子上堆满了各种废弃的高科技设备，墙边则小心地摆放着属于几家知名企业的箱子。最后，我们终于找到了追踪已久的信号源：一个与我们自己的设备相似的应答机。

在我们登录设备并查看其数据库后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]得出一个大胆的结论：该信号被故意设计得尽可能神秘和引人入胜——它模仿结合了其他文明的特征。

此外，在箱子里我们还发现了地面上废墟所使用的建造模件。

于是我们联系基地，开始汇报当前地发现，但宇宙风暴已经开始干扰我们的通讯。我们最后接收到来自[Root.GetLeaderName]的讯息令人担忧，地上营地似乎正遭受攻击！
descriptions.en:
Our progress was briefly halted by a set of badly damaged metal doors. With little effort we worked our way past this obstacle and a rudimentary storage facility revealed itself.

Its shelves were filled to the brim with an assortment of derelict technologies. Boxes of well known corporations had been carefully stacked against the walls. And finally, the source of the signals we had been chasing for so long: a transponder computer not unlike our own.

As we logged into the device and searched its databases, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] started forming a wild conclusion: the signal was deliberately constructed to appear as mysterious and intriguing as possible - mimicking and combining characteristics from other civilizations.

What's more, inside the boxes we found construction kits of the ruins we encountered above ground.

We contacted our basecamp to report our findings, but the cosmic storm has already started interrupting our com lines. The last thing we heard from [Root.GetLeaderName] is a worrying set of commands; it appears our basecamp is under attack!

descriptions.zh:
一支海盗舰队隐藏在[Fromfrom.getName]的宇宙风暴之中！正是它们攻击了我们的基地。这些海盗向我们发送了一条讯息：

§L亲爱的蠢货们：

谢谢你们来到我们这处隐蔽的驻扎地。

看到你们这些看似聪明的生物们闻到一丝古代文物和肮脏遗珍的气息就立刻抛弃一切理智，不禁让人感叹不已。也许你们希望找到一种摧毁强大敌人的手段？建造无数的舰队直抵事件视界？或者只是想让自己的人民过上美好生活？多么俗套的想法啊。

请不要难过——在你们之前还有许多人来过，而我们的商业模式则依赖于那些重蹈你们覆辙的后来人。

现在，只需2000能量币，我们就会把抢来的东西还给你们。

要是拒绝我们的提议，谁知道会发生什么可怕的事情呢，说不定会给[Leader.getHerHim]和[Leader.getHisHer]的这支装备欠佳的船员们带来什么噩运，他们可还被困在这个星球上。

请做出明智之选。§!

躲在洞穴里暂时是安全的，但我们不知道能安全多久。我们要满足这些土匪的要求吗？
descriptions.en:
The cosmic storm inside [Fromfrom.getName] turned out to have been concealing a pirate fleet! It was their crew that attacked our basecamp. The pirates asked us to relay this message to you:

§LDear absolute fools,

Thank you for joining us at our most elusive retreat.

Isn't it amazing just how quickly seemingly intelligent beings abandon all reason whenever they detect the merest whiff of ancient artifacts and devious relics? Perhaps you had hoped to find a means to destroy a great enemy? To build fleets as far as the event horizon reaches? Or were you just trying to be nice to your own people? How quaint.

Please don't feel bad - many others came before you, and our business model depends on that many more will follow your footsteps.

Now, for a modest sum of 2000 energy credits we will return something you have lost.

Reject our offer and who knows what terrible things could happen to [Leader.getHerHim] and [Leader.getHisHer] poorly armed crew that is still trapped on the planet.

Please choose wisely.§!

We are safe in these caverns for now, but we don't know for how long. Are we going to entertain these bandits?

label.zh: 去毁灭之地腐烂成灰吧！
label.en: Tell them to rot in Oblivion!

descriptions.zh:
我们收到一条新讯息：

§L可惜，我们本可以用这笔钱做很多有趣的事情。

我们会转告这位领袖和[Leader.getHisHer]的团队，就说他们的命不值分文。也许附近的奴隶商或一位同化斗士会有兴趣。我们听说精神阉割是现在的新潮流。

就此别过。§!

我们把手头上一切能找到的东西用来修筑壁垒，附近的物资也足够我们撑上一段时间。但海盗们最终肯定会突破我们的防御！
descriptions.en:
We have received a new message:

§LShame. There are a lot of fun things we could've done with those resources.

We will inform the leader and [Leader.getHisHer] crew that their lives weren't worth the effort or credits. Maybe a nearby slaver or a very driven assimilator might be interested. We hear nerve stapling is the hot new trend.

Entrepreneurs out.§!

We have used everything we could find to barricade ourselves in, and there are enough supplies to keep us safe for a while. But the pirate fleet is bound to break through our defenses eventually!

descriptions.zh:
这些海盗的技术完全支持不了它们狂妄的言论。不久之后，他们的舰队成为了星系生态系统的一部分。

我们很快重新与地表的船员们取得联系。他们被吓坏了，但没有受到伤害。

虽然在这里没有发现古代文明的洞见，但这段经历告诉我们以后要提高警惕。探险队领袖未能察觉到眼前的危险——我们以后不能再犯同样的错误。
descriptions.en:
These pirates could not back up their cocky speeches with skill. Before long, whatever was left of their fleet became a part of the galactic ecosystem.

We reestablished contact with the crew on the surface soon after. They were rather shaken by the experience, but suffered no harm.

While we discovered no insights into ancient civilizations here, our experience instilled a need for vigilance. The expedition leader failed to see incoming danger - we will not make the same mistake.

label.en: Let that be a lesson to us all.

options.script:
name = cstorms.1420.a
return_leader_from_exile = green_skies_hostage

label.zh: 这位领袖不会再让我们失望了。
label.en: That leader will never fail us again.

options.script:
name = cstorms.1420.b
kill_exiled_leader = green_skies_hostage

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了回复的讯息：

§L如果可以的话，我愿意称之为明智之选！

请知悉，您对于“急需度假星球的弱势企业家”的拨款已经收到。

很快你们就能再见到你们的领袖和随人附赠的船员。

此外，您可以向所有贸易伙伴推荐我们。§!

不久之后，我们重新与地表船员建立了联系。他们称自己被吓坏了，但没有受到伤害。

虽然在这里没有发现古代文明的洞见，但这段经历告诉我们以后要提高警惕。探险队领袖未能察觉到眼前的危险——我们以后不能再犯同样的错误。
descriptions.en:
We've received a message in return:

§LMarvelous choice, if we may say so!

Let it be known that your contribution to our 'Fund for Disadvantaged Entrepreneurs in Need of a Resort Planet' has been received and processed.

You will find your leader and the complimentary crew in your possession soon enough.

And do recommend us to all your trade partners.§!

Soon after we were able to reestablish contact with the crew on the surface. They reported to be rather shaken by the experience, but suffered no harm.

While we discovered no insights into ancient civilizations here, our experience instilled a need for vigilance. The expedition leader failed to see incoming danger - we will not make the same mistake.

label.en: Let that be a lesson to us all.

return_leader_from_exile = green_skies_hostage

label.en: That leader will never fail us again.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]着实费了一番巧劲才登上空间站并重启望远镜，终究还是没有什么能难倒他们。然而，望远镜瞄向的地方并没有什么值得特别注意的东西。

我们发现空间站周围散布着一些有趣的文物，那是望远镜所拍下的清晰照片，它们被放在精美的相框中。这些照片都是关于宇宙风暴的，它们详细记录了经过该恒星系的所有风暴并且每一次都拍摄了多张照片。望远镜操作员更换变焦，从不同角度进行拍摄，甚至还艺术地倾斜镜头来展示风暴最美的景象。

深入调查后，我们在这座废弃站点上的唯一发现就是这些有趣的艺术作品。我们将对它们进行归档，以便让后来人能够欣赏到这些罕见的、充满力量和美感的图像。
descriptions.en:
Boarding the station and activating the telescopes took some finessing from our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural], but it was nothing they could not handle. However, the corner of the galaxy the instruments were pointed at showed nothing of note.

Some interesting artifacts were found scattered around the station: detailed images recorded from the telescopes, neatly presented in decorative frames. Every single capture is focussed on cosmic storms, with multiple prints of each storm that has passed through this system. The telescope operator used different angles, zoom levels, and even artistic tilts to show the storms in their best light.

Upon deeper investigation, the artwork is the only interesting find aboard the abandoned station. We will archive them so many future generations can enjoy these images of rare power and beauty.

descriptions.zh:
据报道，在最近的§Y磁力风暴§!之后，[this.GetName]出现了不寻常的后遗症。风暴的强大能量场增加了行星熔融核心的磁场波动，导致科技基础设施普遍失灵。

然而，这种情况也提供了一个绝无仅有的资源开采机会。地幔下富含金属的熔岩流被带上了电荷，可以在采矿磁铁的帮助下收获。
descriptions.en:
Unusual after effects are being reported on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent §YMagnetic Storm§!. The storm's potent energy fields increased magnetic volatility in the planet's molten core, resulting in the widespread failure of technological infrastructure.

However, the situation also presents a unique resource extraction opportunity. Metal-rich lava flows underneath the planet's mantle are now electromagnetically charged and can be harvested with the aid of mining magnets.

descriptions.zh: 在最近的§Y电力风暴§!后，[this.GetName]上观察到了一种异常现象。该行星的[GetOceansState]现已充斥着永久性的电流，电流在广阔的水体中循环，对水生生物构成致命威胁。
descriptions.en: An unusual phenomenon has been observed on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent §YElectric Storm§!. The planet's [GetOceansState] have been left charged with a perpetual electrical current now circulating in this vast body of water, posing lethal risks for aquatic life.

descriptions.zh: 这对我们殖民地的生存前景构成严重威胁，必须立即加以解决。
descriptions.en: This represents a serious threat for our colony's survival prospects and must be addressed immediately.

descriptions.zh: 这种现象对我们没有造成直接的伤害，但对我们殖民地的未来发展产生了挑战。
descriptions.en: This phenomenon is causing us no direct harm but poses challenges to our colony's future development.

options.script:
name = cstorms.1715.b
add_deposit = d_electrified_oceans

descriptions.zh: 在最近[this.solar_system.GetName]的§Y虚境风暴§!事件后，[owner.GetColonistPlural]报告称在某个孤立的峡谷中发现了难以解释的神秘现象。幽灵般的蓝色身影短暂出现，似乎无法或不愿与我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]互动，只是漫无目的地徘徊，随后消失。
descriptions.en: Following the recent §YShroud Storm§! in [this.solar_system.GetName], [owner.GetColonistPlural] report inexplicable sightings of ethereal apparitions in an isolated canyon. These ghostly blue figures appear briefly, unable or unwilling to interact with our [owner.GetColonistPlural], wandering aimlessly before dissipating.

descriptions.zh: 虽然这些幽灵在本质上似乎是灵能体，但我们仍无法与他们建立任何灵能交流。然而，系统检查倒是能确认他们的出现给我们的心灵感应能力带来了积极的帮助。
descriptions.en: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any psionic communication with these entities. However, system checks have confirmed that their presence provides passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.

descriptions.zh: 虽然这些幽灵在本质上似乎是灵能体，但我们仍无法与这些实体建立任何数量的精神交流。然而，我们发现他们的存在是对我们心灵感应能力的被动强化。
descriptions.en: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any amount of mental communication with these entities. However, we have found their presence to be a passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.

descriptions.zh: 这一非凡现象提醒我们，我们的生存中有着无形的奇迹。
descriptions.en: This remarkable phenomenon is providing a welcome reminder of the intangible wonders of our existence.

descriptions.zh: 截止目前为止，没有进一步的人身伤害或损害的报告。
descriptions.en: No physical harm or aggressive behavior has thus far been reported.

descriptions.zh: 截止目前为止，没有人身伤害或损害的报告。尽管如此，这种奇怪的现象还是令人不安地分散了人们的注意力。
descriptions.en: No physical harm or damage has thus far been reported. Nonetheless, the strange phenomenon is proving to be an unsettling distraction.

label.zh: 用泥土填满峡谷。死者将被埋葬。
label.en: Fill the canyon with earth. The dead will stay buried.

options.script:
name = FASCINATING
add_deposit = d_ghostly_canyon

descriptions.zh:
最近的§H[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!残留的辐射导致§Y[this.GetName]§!上的地质活动变得异常。

尤其值得注意的是，风暴的影响使得一座活火山不再活跃，将其与地质学上的热点隔离，切断了岩浆供应。

由于冷却的岩浆开拓了新的土地，进一步开发这颗行星的新机遇因这些变化而呈现于我们面前。
descriptions.en:
The residual radiation from the recent §Y[this.GetAffectedStormType]§! has led to erratic geological activity across §H[this.GetName]§!.

Most notably, the impact of the storm has rendered an active volcano extinct, cutting it off from its geological hotspot and severing the supply of magma.

These changes present us with new opportunities to develop the planet further, as the cooling magma opens up new lands.

descriptions.zh:
一场严重的§Y重力风暴§!导致了§H[this.GetName]§!的地景发生了剧变。这场风暴强劲的重力波动将行星最高的山脉从构造架上剥离，径直提到了星球的上方。

它现在仍然悬浮在上层大气中，由风暴的残余引力作用保持在高空。这一剧变使得地下基岩中以前无法开采的矿物贮藏暴露了出来，也为[owner.GetResearchers]提供了很多可以分析的资料。
descriptions.en:
A severe §YGravity Storm§! caused an extraordinary transformation of §H[this.GetName]§!'s landscape. The storm's powerful gravitational fluctuations severed the planet's largest mountain range from its tectonic shelf, lifting it vertically above the planet.

It remains suspended in the upper atmosphere, held aloft by a residual gravitational effect of the storm. This remarkable upheaval has exposed previously inaccessible ore reserves in the bedrock underneath, as well as providing [owner.GetResearchers] with much to analyze.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
add_deposit = d_sky_mountain

descriptions.zh: 近期的§Y[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!对[this.GetName]的气候产生了意想不到的影响。
descriptions.en: The recent §Y[this.GetAffectedStormType]§! has had an unexpected impact on the climate of [this.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
大气中积聚的电荷导致了两极地区的剧烈温度变化。让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
descriptions.en:
The increased electrical charge in the atmosphere has led to a drastic temperature shift in the polar region, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

descriptions.zh:
大气中积聚的电荷导致了两极地区的剧烈温度变化。让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
descriptions.en:
The corrosive effect of the storm's particles has heavily impacted the polar regions, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

descriptions.zh:
风暴带来的重力变化将许多水下冰层撕裂，让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
descriptions.en:
The gravitational shifts brought on by the storm have shattered multiple layers of subaquatic ice, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

descriptions.zh:
产生的行星磁场扰动导致了剧烈的地震运动，让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
descriptions.en:
The resulting disturbances in the planets magnetic fields have led to drastic seismic shifts, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

descriptions.zh:
风暴的极端热量在其持续期间内提升了整颗行星的温度，让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
descriptions.en:
The extreme heat of the storm raised the temperatures across the planet throughout its duration, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

descriptions.zh:
高浓度超热星尘严重地影响了两极地区，让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
descriptions.en:
Large concentrations of superheated celestial dust have heavily impacted the polar regions, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[this.GetName]§!的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报§Y星尘风暴§!它对水过滤系统有不利影响。随着颗粒在星球地下水中沉淀，形成的矿浆堵塞了关键的基础设施。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on §H[this.GetName]§! report that the §YStardust Storm§! is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.

descriptions.zh: 在研究水培堵塞的过程中，我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现，矿化的浆液本身对石质生理学人口实际上既美味又有营养。在对殖民地的过滤系统进行了一些小调整之后，它们大量生产了一种新的季节性饮料，可以供应到风暴结束。
descriptions.en: While investigating the hydroponic blockages, our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovered that the mineralized slurry itself is actually both delicious and nutritious when consumed by those with lithoid physiology. After making a few minor adjustments to the colony's filtration systems they have mass-produced a new seasonal drink with which to wait out the storm.

descriptions.zh:
由此导致的水培故障严重影响了星球上的农业，也导致了安全饮用水的短缺。

这个问题如果不加以处理，可能会对我们的供水造成长期的影响。幸运的是，我们的[owner.GetEngineerPlural]有信心他们可以创造更强大的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
descriptions.en:
The resulting hydroponic failures are heavily impacting the planet's agriculture, as well as leading to shortages in safe drinkable water.

This problem could have long-lasting consequences on our water supply if not dealt with. Fortunately, our [owner.GetEngineerPlural] are confident they can create more robust filtration systems to address the issue.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]解决了§H[this.GetName]§!上的水培阻塞和用水短缺的问题。殖民地的水供应网络得到了升级，现在可以滤去星尘风暴所带来的复杂杂质。

这些对用水基础设施的改进还可以用来提升[Owner.GetName]上的灌溉作业。
descriptions.en:
The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have dealt with the hydroponic blockages and water shortages on §H[this.GetName]§!. The colony's water supply network has been improved and can now filter out complex impurities such as those introduced by the Stardust Storm.

These improvements to our water infrastructure can be repurposed to improve irrigation efforts across the [Owner.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们观察到§Y重力风暴§!对当地野生鸟类带来了严重的影响。

风暴带来的重力波动导致了异常的大气条件，让许多鸟类物种无法飞行。
descriptions.en:
The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] on [this.GetName] have observed harsh repercussions of the §YGravity Storm§! on the local avian wildlife.

The gravitational fluctuations brought on by the storm are leading to erratic atmospheric conditions, rendering several species of avian fauna incapable of flight.

descriptions.zh: 真正的盛宴等待着我们。
descriptions.en: A veritable feast awaits us.

descriptions.zh:
这不仅使它们无法正常捕猎，也更容易受到捕食者攻击。

有人担心，如果我们不加以干预，这些受影响的物种可能会被赶尽杀绝。
descriptions.en:
Not only is this preventing the creatures unable to hunt as normal, it is also leaving them vulnerable to predators.

There is concern that the afflicted species may be hunted to extinction if we do not intervene.

label.zh: 把这些生物放入保护区。
label.en: Place the creatures in a reserve.

label.zh: 在事态结束之前保存它们的基因物质。
label.en: Save their DNA before the end.

descriptions.zh:
紧接着§Y重力风暴§!过境之后，[this.GetName]上暂时无法飞行的在我们的鸟类保护区内避难，又一次翱翔天空。

虽然许多动物现在已经回到了它们以前的栖息地，但仍有相当数量的动物留在保护区，似乎在享受保护区提供的舒适和保护。

这为近距离研究这颗星球上的野生鸟类提供了一个独特的机会。
descriptions.en:
Following the passing of the §YGravity Storm§!, the temporarily flightless fauna of [this.GetName] have taken to the skies again having taken shelter inside our avian reserve.

While many of the creatures have now returned to their former habitats, significant numbers remain in the reserve, seemingly enjoying the comforts and protections it provides.

This presents a unique opportunity to study the planet's avian wildlife at close proximity.

options.script:
name = cstorms.1776.a
add_deposit = d_avian_reserve

descriptions.zh: 扫描发现，在[from.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]的中心出现了不规则现象，表明该构造的中心携带着一个奇怪的物质。这些不寻常的读数值得在风暴消散或离开该恒星系之前进行更深入的调查。
descriptions.en: Scans detect irregularities in the eye of [fromfrom.GetName] raging in [from.GetName], indicating that the formation is carrying a strange mass at its center. These unusual readings warrant closer investigation, before the storm dissipates or leaves the system.

descriptions.zh:
通过进入[from.GetName]的宇宙风暴眼，[leader.GetName]发现了我们扫描不规则的原因。这场不寻常的风暴是由巨大的中心[from.star.GetEarnedResources]聚集所推动的。

我们的科研船在被猛烈地弹射出去之前收获了可以收集的资源。传感器的数据将帮助我们的工程师在极端风暴条件下提高船只的性能。
descriptions.en:
By navigating into the eye of the cosmic storm in [from.GetName], [leader.GetName] discovered the cause of our scan irregularities. This unusual storm is being fueled by a huge central concentration of [from.star.GetEarnedResources].

Our science ship harvested what resources could be gathered before being violently ejected. The sensor data from their narrow withdrawal will aid our engineers in improving vessel performance under extreme storm conditions.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是，这种危险的折磨对[leader.GetName]产生了持久的影响。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately, this dangerous ordeal has had a lasting impact on [leader.GetName].

links.script: system_event = { id = cstorms.1816 scopes = { from = this } }

descriptions.zh:
一个神秘的太空舱飘在§H[from.GetName]§!中。它看起来没有任何攻击能力并且对我们的信号毫无反应。

初步扫描显示它受损的外部是用先进的材料和陌生的工程科技建造的。需要进一步分析。
descriptions.en:
A mysterious capsule is adrift in §H[from.GetName]§!. It has no obvious offensive capability and is unresponsive to our signals.

Initial scans show that its damaged exterior is constructed using advanced materials and unfamiliar engineering techniques. Further analysis is needed.

descriptions.zh:
一个神秘的太空舱飘在§H[from.GetName]§!中。它看起来没有任何攻击能力并且对我们的信号毫无反应。

初步扫描显示它受损的外部是用先进的材料和陌生的工程科技建造的。需要进一步分析。
descriptions.en:
A mysterious capsule is adrift in §H[from.GetName]§!. It has no obvious offensive capability and is unresponsive to our signals.

Initial scans show that its damaged exterior is constructed using advanced materials and unfamiliar engineering techniques. Further analysis is needed.

descriptions.zh:
[this.leader.GetName]相信飘过[solar_system.GetName]星系的神秘太空舱是一种古老的“风暴陷阱”，可能曾是一个更大的防御系统的一部分。

这个设备的进气口密封得很紧，但我们的扫描显示它里面藏有被俘获其中的高度压缩的宇宙风暴能量和物质。

研究如何这个非凡的容器可能会教会我们很多关于抑制风暴的知识，但也有释放其蕴含的所有能量的风险。
descriptions.en:
[this.leader.GetName] believes that the mysterious capsule drifting through the [solar_system.GetName] system is an ancient "storm trap", which may have once been part of a larger defense grid.

The device's intake port is sealed tightly, but our readings suggest it is holding the compressed energy and matter of a captive cosmic storm inside.

Finding a way to open this remarkable container may teach us a great deal about storm mitigation, although at the risk of releasing whatever forces are currently contained within.

label.zh: 这里有很多值得学习的东西。
label.en: There is much to learn here.

descriptions.zh:
[leader.GetName]完成了对古老风暴陷阱工作原理的分析，并解开了其输入装置。随着端口打开，§H[from.GetStormType]§!内部的风暴被释放到[solar_system.GetName]星系的虚空中。

对陷阱复杂工程的研究已经对抗风暴材料和结构产生了惊人的洞见，尽管我们仍然不明白这个装置是如何能够完全控制风暴的。这些知识将极大地帮助我们抵御未来的宇宙扰动。
descriptions.en:
[leader.GetName] completed analysis of the ancient storm trap's workings and was able to unlock its intake mechanism. As the ports opened, the §H[from.GetStormType]§! held inside was released into the void of the [solar_system.GetName] system.

Study of the trap's complex engineering has produced fascinating insights into storm-resistant materials and structures, though we still do not understand how the device is capable of containing storms entirely. This knowledge will greatly aid us in weathering future cosmic disturbances.

tooltips.zh: [solar_system.GetName]星系中诞生了一场小规模的低等级§Y宇宙风暴§!
tooltips.en: A small, low-level §YCosmic Storm§! spawns in the [solar_system.GetName] system

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们深表同情！我们目睹了一场大风暴在[this.GetName]肆虐。

听到那里遭到的破坏，我们当然感到非常难过。我们哭了，我们真的哭了！所以，请允许我们帮个忙……这是一笔特别的一次性超级交易！

我们可以提供一些小工具，一流的小工具。是我们能给的最好的！有了这些，当下一次风暴来临时，你就能做好准备了。那么我们成交吧？
descriptions.en:
Commiserations, [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We chanced to see a big storm wreaking havoc in [this.GetName].

Of course, we were very sad to hear of the damage done there. We cried, indeed we cried! So please, allow us to help... with a special one time super deal!

We can provide gadgets, first class gadgets. Only the best from us! With these, when the next storm comes, you will be ready. So do we have a deal?

options.script: name = cstorms.1835.b

descriptions.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
descriptions.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

options.script: name = cstorms.8510.a

descriptions.zh: 一股灵能浪潮席卷了[from.GetName]，使其部分人口发生了违背自然法则的改变。整个群体都被重塑了，它们的形态变得奇怪而陌生，仿佛有某种我们无法理解的东西改写了他们的本质。
descriptions.en: A surge of psionic energy has swept through [from.GetName], leaving parts of its population altered in ways that defy natural law. Entire groups have been reshaped, their forms now alien and unfamiliar, as if something beyond our understanding has rewritten their very essence.

options.script: name = cstorms.8515.a

descriptions.zh: 一股灵能浪潮重塑了[from.GetName]，时期变成了一颗具有截然不同性质的新恒星。如今，一颗[from.GetClassName]正向[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系投射着它怪异的光，仿佛现实本身被扭曲了一般。
descriptions.en: A surge of psionic energy has remade [from.GetName], transforming it into a star of an entirely new nature. Now, a [from.GetClassName] casts its strange light upon the [from.solar_system.GetName] System, as if reality itself has been altered.

label.zh: 即使是恒星也未能幸免……
label.en: Even the stars are not immune...

options.script: name = cstorms.8520.a

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!上遗弃设施的入口建设得格外地坚固。显然非常地耐用，外表铺着有厚重的装甲、辐射护盾和一座气象传感阵列。§H[Leader.GetName]§!相信它是用来抵御极端条件的。

扫描表明，通过数道密封的安全门之后可以抵达一座巨大的地下舱室。
descriptions.en:
The entrance of the isolated complex on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§! is of exceptionally robust construction. Clearly built to last, its exterior features heavy armor plating, radiation shields, and an array of atmospheric sensors. §H[Leader.GetName]§! believes it was built to withstand extreme conditions.

Scans suggest that a large underground chamber can be accessed via a series of sealed security doors.

descriptions.zh:
在进入主要舱室后，§H[Leader.GetName]§!得出结论，我们发现了一座很久以前为某些未知有机物种建造的尚未启用的生存避难所。

它配备了储备充足的居住区，包括睡眠舱、休闲区和医疗舱。每层楼的储物柜里都有大量未开封的营养包、电池和工具。这座隐藏的洞穴里的所有东西都处于未使用的状态。

最后一扇安全门仍然密封这着，我们相信打开它便会到达基地的指挥室。
descriptions.en:
Having gained access to the main interior, §H[Leader.GetName]§! concludes that we have discovered an unused survival shelter, built long ago for some unknown organic species.

It is outfitted with well stocked habitation quarters comprising sleep pods, leisure zones, and a medical bay. Storage lockers on every floor hold deep reserves of unopened nutrient packs, batteries, and tools. Everything contained in this hidden vault is in pristine condition.

One final set of security doors remains sealed. We believe they will lead us to the facility's command deck.

descriptions.zh:
这座舱室的指挥面板上有一组令人印象深刻的§Y宇宙风暴§!显示器，全部连接着外面的气象探测阵列。这些控制台在待机状态运行后，储存了了几个世纪以来的历史风暴数据，这将极大地促进我们对星际气象学的理解。

§H[Leader.GetName]§!还找到了一台精致小巧的全息投影仪。当被激活时，它会投射出一个3D的软体类模型，从带着公司标志的庇护所地标边跑过，一边进行着推销。

这个幸存的产品是否找到了买家不得而知，但它显然已经在这里闲置了很多年。
descriptions.en:
The shelter's command deck is equipped with an impressive array of §YCosmic Storm§! monitors, all fed by the atmospheric sensors on the surface. After running on standby, these consoles contain centuries' worth of historical storm data, which will greatly advance our understanding of astrometeorology.

§H[Leader.GetName]§! also found a small and well-used holo-projector. When activated, it beams a 3D molluscoid figure delivering a sales pitch, running through the shelter's key features under a corporate logo.

Whether this survival product ever found a buyer is impossible to say, but it has clearly remained unused here for many years.

descriptions.zh: 我们的营销部门已经在分析哪里出了问题。
descriptions.en: Our marketing departments are already analyzing where they went wrong.

descriptions.zh: 过境的宇宙风暴留下的不仅仅是毁灭。在[Planet.GetName]上，它还创造了一个全新的地理特征。
descriptions.en: A passing cosmic storm has left more than mere devastation in its wake. On [Planet.GetName], it has created an entirely new geographical feature.
